root.new_law: Primitive oriented quaternion field F_i is the irreducible complex two-dimensional left module, repeated with multiplicity exactly3. The six-dimensional field matrices F_i=sigma_i tensor I3, and material physical spin S_i=F_i/2, are INPUTS; not free Dirac gamma matrices or a derivation from the old irreducible Clifford4.
root.derivation: Solve [X,F_i]=0 as a linear system on actual36 complex matrix entries. Nullity9 plus nine independent explicit intertwiners I2 tensor E_ab gives the full M3(C) commutant. Unitary commutant U3, traceless determinant-one subgroup SU3. Choosing to gauge SU3 rather than its full U3 is a further law.
root.primitive_statistics: Two u-flavour quanta and one d-flavour quantum in the chosen charge1 sector. Exact first-quantized antisymmetry of the identical u labels is isomorphic to the corresponding CAR sector; d has distinct flavour. No antiquark/sea Hilbert space.
root.primitive_charges: q_u=2/3, q_d=-1/3. These are not derived proton constants.

gauss.geometry: Three sites of an equilateral triangle routed in three-dimensional space, with tree links01 and12 and chord20. Coordinates may be (0,0,0),(1,0,0),(1/2,1/2,1/sqrt2). Only the loop U20 is retained as a quantum coordinate after EXACT maximal-tree gauge fixing.
gauss.constraints: Oriented link matrix transports source to destination. Before gauge fixing: G0=q0+L01+Lloop; G1=q1+R01+L12; G2=q2+R12+Rloop. In tree gauge R01=-L01 and R12=-L12, hence E12=q2+Rloop, E01=q1+q2+Rloop, and residual G0=qtotal+Lloop+Rloop=0. G1,G2 vanish identically. Matter charges are parallel transported to root.
gauss.electric: H_E=g2/2 sum_a(length01 E01_a^2 + length12 E12_a^2 + length20 Rloop_a^2). This includes noncommuting matter charge, loop left/right and cross feedback, not a scalar span potential or ad hoc negative attraction.
gauss.physical_space: Kernel of sum_a G0_a^2 in3 tensor3 tensor3 tensor PW19, NOT separately matter-singlet. Allows matter-octet times loop-adjoint dressing. Position and all M=+1/2 spin states are then included before antisymmetrizing the two u quanta. Both S1/2 and S3/2 channels remain; the opposite M channels are their exact SU2 partners.

External scalar EM density impulse exp(-i pulse rho0) commutes with loop observables initially, then the actual H causes current and quantum-loop reaction.
hamiltonian.response: Diagonalize the complete finite fermionic Hilbert space. All baryon-source and current transition weights are retained, including negative-frequency retarded denominators, inelastic virtual states and contact. No contact-only truncation.

These are same-H finite-cavity variational separation costs, not a free-coloured E1+E2 threshold or proof of infinite-volume confinement.
